rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=200, epochs=40, batch_size=2, lr=0.0002, uswin_c=24, swin_window=16, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-3 (breast-ct-claude-agentic-uswin-search-20260703-01). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) READ iter-1 vs iter-2: hr 0.648994 (ep8) -> 0.819250 (ep40), val_ssim 0.990973 -> 0.997713, PSNR 45.42 -> 51.18, RMSE 1.83e-3 -> 9.42e-4. iter-2 wall 00:14:28 (867s) = 72pct of the HARD 20-min budget. Epochs lever CONFIRMED strong (+0.170 hr for 8->40). iter-2 ALREADY EXCEEDS the prior 256px U-Swin champion 0.7174. (2) LIMITER: epochs nearly exhausted WITHIN BUDGET (867s at ep40; ep64 would be ~23min and blow the 20-min wall). Open question: is hr 0.819 CAPACITY-limited at swin_window=8? Prior-campaign insight (solver_uswin.md) is explicit: the denser breast anatomy favored a WIDER window + more heads (256px breast champion used win=16, heads=8). iter-1/2 used memory-safe win=8; the wider-window lever is untested on the 512px substrate. (3) ONE KNOB: swin_window 8 -> 16; everything else identical to iter-2 (epochs=40, bs=2, lr=2e-4, uswin_c=24, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: hr 0.819 is capacity-limited by the narrow 8px window on the dense 512px breast substrate; widening to 16px (2x window area) captures more non-local streak context and lifts hr above 0.819 toward 0.85+, mirroring the prior breast champion. FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.819 at win=16, the window was not the limiter -> iter-4 pivots to swin_heads 4->8 or lr. (5) BUDGET GUARD: win=16 ~doubles attention cost (~35-40 s/epoch), so 40 epochs could reach ~26 min; the max_train_s=1000 (16.7 min) TRAIN-ONLY backstop caps training and still yields a valid val-scored result inside the 30-min sbatch wall. This stays a strict ONE-KNOB change (I did NOT also cut epochs). HARD 20-min honored via backstop; val_n=200 = whole val pool. (6) I dispatch iter-4 myself when iter-3 lands.
